settingsSlot.maxFileHint: Image-heavy PPT / PDF often exceed 25MB. Over the limit, originals are still imported but not auto-converted to Markdown.
settingsSlot.enhanceDesc: Not bundled with the app. Built-ins handle docx / pdf text / xlsx / pptx / email; local tools improve quality
settingsSlot.notYetChecked: Not yet checked; auto-detects on first open
settingsSlot.installHint: Make sure to use markitdown[all] (includes PPTX etc.). After installing in terminal, click "Re-check"; results are cached and won't scan PATH on every settings open. On Windows if still not detected, confirm Python 3 is installed and fully restart Desktop.
